mpf.source: 積金局（MPFA）：僱員強制性供款
mpf.asOf_en: Maximum relevant income $30,000 since 2014-06-01; minimum relevant income $7,100 since 2014-11-01
mpf.note: 積金局正進行 2022–2026 年度嘅入息上下限法定檢討。傳媒報道嘅建議數字各有不同（例如下限約 $10,500–$11,000、上限約 $35,000–$40,000），但截至 2026-11-27 政府仍未公布決定，現行上下限照用。一旦落實，網站會即時更新。
mpf.note_en: The MPFA is carrying out its statutory review of the income limits for 2022–2026. Media reports give different proposed figures (for example a minimum of about $10,500–$11,000 and a maximum of about $35,000–$40,000), but as of 2026-11-27 the government had not announced a decision, so the current limits still apply. The site will be updated as soon as any change takes effect.
